pending_commit.commit_message: hammerd: Trackpad update without SHA verification As an initial commit, this doesn't contain the SHA verification. It updates trackpad firmware whatever assigned in the hammerd.conf, but skip if (1) The local binary seems to have same checksum with base. (2) Assigned path to touchpad firmware is not exist. In addition, rename image to ec_image since we introduced trackpad_image and unified naming of trackpad to touchpad per product definition. CHROMIUM: MALI: Avoid waiting forever in kbase_jm_wait_for_zero_jobs() It appears that kbase_jm_wait_for_zero_jobs() was re-inventing wait_event_timeout(). This added a bunch of unneeded complexity was also the source of a few bugs. Specifically: 1. Even after the timeout the old code kept waiting on the two conditions to become true. The old code would have done that since the old timeout callback did nothing to cause the old wait_event() functions to stop waiting (it's been validated that calling kbase_reset_gpu() wasn't enough to cause "job_nr" to become 0). 2. Even if KBASE_GPU_RESET_EN was not defined the old code still pretended that the reset happened and still waited on reset_wait. Let's use wait_event_timeout() and fix the bugs. BUG=b:64852540 TEST=Build and boot Change-Id: I7c828a72cb9e7214aa6b0ebf218aba8913326a41 Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/642133 Reviewed-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: John Einar Reitan <john.reitan@arm.com> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
